D. A. Brading, Mexican Phoenix: Our Lady of Guadalupe — Image and Tradition across Five Centuries (Cambridge University Press, 2001)
The cult of Our Lady of Guadalupe at Tepeyac and the documented Tonantzin association (esp. Sahagun's report); used for the Guadalupe-Tonantzin syncretism seam.
Jim Pieper, Guatemala's Folk Saints: Maximon/San Simon, Rey Pascual, Judas, Lucifer, and Others (Pieper and Associates, 2002)
The living Guatemalan folk-saint cult of Maximon and his identification with San Simon and Judas Iscariot, and the underlying Maya figure Mam; used for the Mam/Maximon syncretism seam.
